title: ericameria gilmanii
intro: Ericameria gilmanii, commonly known as the Antelope Brush, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, belonging to the daisy family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, antimicrobial properties, and antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Ericameria gilmanii are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
